//indexCommand: Refreshes the index before the dup gate, bounded under the 60s refresh timeout. A linked or ship worktree refreshes its own copy of the primary's index, never the primary; {staged-csv} (unquoted: it expands already quoted) re-embeds the staged files first.
//generated: Paths ship's three-way staging abort points at a generator instead of a hand-merge (sc-2770). .devkit/*-manifest.json are built-in defaults.
//extraGates: devkit's own command gates, declared the way a consumer declares them, so a failure has one source for its command. hook-parity and formatter-identity fail the commit that breaks generator parity, not the next push. release-only-dist runs CI's release-only dist check from the ship worktree's own copy. corpus-lint is the structural half of `bench.mts validate`. related-tests runs the tests vitest relates to the staged paths ({staged}), so a test the change breaks blocks before any AI judge runs. It is afterGreen: it runs last, and only when every other deterministic gate passed, because a fix to an earlier failure changes the staged tree and discards its verdict. typecheck covers e2e/, which no test run does, so an export only an e2e file imports cannot vanish unseen. run-as-main runs the realpath run-as-main sweep, which reads source text and so is never related to a staged file. skill-projection blocks provider-skill drift the staged change caused.
//gateTimeoutMs: Per-gate deadline for guard-deterministic (default 30 min). Raised here because related-tests has legitimately run for about 32 minutes on a loaded machine before reporting a real failure.
//comments: devkit is open source: a comment citing a private Shortcut ticket, an autonomous report id or a decision record means nothing to an outside reader, and a file:line anchor rots on the next edit, so guard-comments blocks changed comments that cite either.
//evidence: devkit ship runs a PR's added or changed test files on red (the PR base plus those files) and green (the PR head) after the PR opens, and writes the outcome into the PR body.
//research: Sibling clones the prior-art agent may read (agents/prior-art.md). Unresolved entries are skipped, so a clone without them stays valid. ../frink-oss is the live Frink repository; the archived ../frink clone is left out on purpose.
//review: devkit's own ships pin the judges to Claude so they do not depend on codex quota; consumers without a pin keep the codex defaults in gate-engine/config.mts. backendRoots covers code that runs in consumer repos (skills, agents-hooks, templates, devkit's own anti-slop rules) and devkit's build and test infrastructure. The pinned upstream anti-slop rules and docs/benchmarks/experiments get correctness review only; e2e/fixtures is deliberately bad code and is excluded.

review.trustBoundaries: devkit is a CLI + portable gate-engine, not a hosted app — no server/client split. Its trust model is W-3: devkit ships inside the consumer's node_modules and EXECUTES in a repo it does not own, so every path it resolves must be consumer-cwd-relative, never __dirname, and synced assets (skills/agents/gate scripts) must read layout from the consumer's guard.config.json, never hardcode a stack's directory tree.

//maxLines: Raw line cap per source file (guard-size ratchet enforces it; existing giants grandfathered shrink-only in .devkit/baselines/size-lines.json). 0 = off. Per-FUNCTION caps need a parser — not yet.
//maxTestLines: Loose raw line cap per test file; existing oversized tests are grandfathered shrink-only in .devkit/baselines/size-lines.json. 0 = off.
//maxLinesExtensions: Extra extensions the raw-line cap also governs. The ship scripts are shell, and only guard-size can hold them shrink-only on every judge model.
//mergeVerdict: devkit reaches consumers only through devkit release, which needs green CI, so merging to main is not the consumer boundary. The verdict's own code stays human-reviewed so a change cannot certify itself. fix and feat get larger limits than the built-in 50 lines / 4 files.
